supporting_observations.claim: From 13:36 through 13:51 UTC, svc-inventory authentication failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals from FILE-BLU-01. The records show logon type 3 and incorrect-password status (SubStatus 0xc000006a).

The periodic failures are consistent with the documented InventorySync job re-authenticating every minute on FILE-BLU-01 and the scheduled svc-inventory password rotation at 13:30 UTC; this is a plausible benign explanation, but the logs do not confirm the rotation or that the job caused the attempts.

Before the scheduled rotation, explicit credentials for svc-inventory were used by SYSTEM running PowerShell on WS-EBROOKS-01 and WS-MSANTOS-01, targeting DC-BLU-01 and FILE-BLU-01 respectively. These workstation uses are not explained by the supplied service-account context.

The available records do not establish whether the workstation credential use was authorized or whether it is connected to the later FILE-BLU-01 failures; that unresolved activity prevents a confident benign disposition.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records identify PowerShell and process IDs for the workstation explicit-credential events, but do not provide command lines, parent processes, or the responsible interactive user.
Proxy logs were not collected from 13:25 to 14:10 UTC. This is a gap for network correlation, though it does not by itself explain the authentication events.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-inventory password was actually rotated at 13:30 UTC, and when the InventorySync job's stored credential was updated.
Whether the two workstation explicit-credential events were approved administrative or operational activity.
Whether any svc-inventory authentication succeeded during the review window; the supplied records show failures but do not establish the complete success history.
What command or process activity on FILE-BLU-01 generated the repeated authentication attempts.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the password-rotation and InventorySync credential-update records, including job execution logs around 13:30 UTC.
Collect process creation and PowerShell logging for the two workstation events, including command lines, parent processes, script content, and the initiating user.
Review complete domain-controller and FILE-BLU-01 authentication logs for svc-inventory successes and failures during the window.
Confirm with the service owner whether svc-inventory use from WS-EBROOKS-01 and WS-MSANTOS-01 was authorized.
